name: Canvas camera tour
visual_intent: A system laid out as a map larger than the frame: the camera frames each part on its spoken name, drifts in while it holds, and pulls back to show the whole.

performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low (<5MB); transforms and opacity only (estimate, not measured on the M2)

implementation_summary: One transform (x, y, scale, origin 0 0) on a canvas element: per stop a 0.8 s power2.inOut move that frames the target with padding, then a sine.inOut drift to 1.025x about the target centre until the next stop; optional pull-back to the whole canvas. Marks the canvas data-layout-allow-overflow so frame review accepts panels crossing the frame edge mid-pan.
runtime_api: Studio.space.tour(tl, canvas, [{target, at, pad, maxScale}], {move, drift, start: 'overview' | 'first', pullBack, pullDuration})

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-tour-progression/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
